text:
noah: Heads-up: HorizonPay (acct HP-620) dip in active sessions ~50% over 10 days. Renewal in 14 days, marking as at-risk.

isabel: ARR and renewal owner?

noah: $95k ARR, owner is priya@horizonpay.com. Onboarding score 36/100, missed final enablement. NPS=5.

tom: Any product errors or billing disputes?

noah: No billing issues. Support thread SUP-3315 about embeddings irrelevant for invoices. Usage concentrated on invoice-parser endpoint but calls dropped.

isabel: Propose a concise safety-net play: 1) Outreach + 3-question feedback, 2) 30m technical triage within 48h, 3) quick prompt & token audit, 4) reversible config patch (batching + prefix caching + prompt trim), 5) graceful downgrade mapping if they insist. Attach small conditional credit. Keep discount off table unless needed.

priya: Please draft the one-pager I can send to CTO. Also include a short migration checklist in case they want to downgrade.

noah: Draft checklist below (owners & timeline).

```
- outreach email + 3Q feedback (owner: priya) within 12h
- schedule 30m triage with eng (owner: isabel) within 48h
- prompt & token audit: top-5 endpoints and token sinks (owner: tom) by EOD after triage
- reversible config patch (batching + KV prefix caching + prompt shortener) + rollback script (owner: tom)
- prepare downgrade mapping doc (feature impact + migration steps) (owner: isabel)
- offer: conditional 21-day usage credit tied to completing the triage and applying patch (owner: priya)
- escalation: no response in 48h -> tag csm_lead (owner: noah)
```

tom: I'll pull top endpoints now. Example query I'll run: 
```
SELECT endpoint, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, COUNT(*) AS calls
FROM usage.events
WHERE account='HP-620' AND ts > now()-14d
GROUP BY endpoint
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

isabel: I'll prep a 1-pager for CTO: two tracks (Optimize = recommended, Downgrade = fallback) with bullets on expected token savings and rollback time. Keep it one page.

priya: Outreach sent. Asked for Tue/Thu slots and attached the 3Q feedback form.

cse_bot: Account snapshot added: https://redwood.app/account/HP-620/health | onboarding 36/100, last enablement 52d ago, NPS=5. Save-play artifact attached to timeline.

noah: If we confirm the triage and show >15% token reduction we push for renewal extension conversation. If they opt to downgrade, give them a clear, reversible migration with a 48h rollback window.

tom: Posting initial audit notes by EOD. Early signal: repeated invoice metadata per call and an overly verbose system prompt are main token sinks; simple dedupe + prompt trim should save ~20%.

priya: Thanks team. I'll update thread with meeting link and attach the one-pager.

isabel: Marking this as "safety-net save" and setting follow-up reminder in 36h. :white_check_mark:
